stories.title: Vets Wilson, Stewart headline youth-infused All-WNBA teams
stories.summary: A'ja Wilson, Breanna Stewart, Caitlin Clark, Kelsey Mitchell and rookie Olivia Miles have been named first-team All-WNBA.

stories.title: LeBron to sit out vs. Bucks in 1st game of back-to-back
stories.summary: LeBron James will miss the Sixers' game Saturday night against the Bucks to manage low back pain/sciatica. It will be his first missed game of the season.

stories.title: Mavs' Flagg out for home opener with mild left shoulder sprain
stories.summary: Mavericks star forward Cooper Flagg had an MRI Saturday morning that revealed a mild left shoulder sprain, the team announced.

stories.title: Sources: Magic's Banchero out multiple weeks with ankle sprain
stories.summary: Magic star Paolo Banchero has sustained a low-grade high ankle sprain, the team announced, with sources telling ESPN that the forward will miss multiple weeks.

stories.title: Ex-NBA player Beasley negotiating plea deal in gambling case
stories.summary: Former NBA player Malik Beasley is negotiating a plea agreement with Department of Justice lawyers over his alleged role in a bribery and betting scheme, one of his attorneys confirmed.
